title: Equivalent Definitions of One-Sided Randomized Polynomial Time
statement: The class of languages decidable in polynomial time by a randomized machine with one-sided error and acceptance probability at least $2/3$ on members equals the class defined in the same way using the fixed member-input acceptance threshold $2/3$.
